description_for_human: Find the best restaurants, cafes, bars, and attractions in any city — curated from Reddit with Google ratings, insider tips, and what to order.
description_for_model: Search tabiji.ai for free AI-curated travel data. The API covers: 6,905 destinations (cities, regions, countries) with budget ratings ($–$$$$), best seasons, vibes, and travel styles; 1,616 curated/bar/cafe/attraction picks guides covering 5,864 curated places with Google ratings, opening hours, Reddit quotes, insider tips, and 'what to order' advice; 373 day-by-day travel itineraries with neighborhoods and activity breakdowns; 1,218 destination comparisons with category-by-category analysis, Reddit quotes, and verdicts; 250 countries with capitals, population, currencies, languages, and factual metadata. Use the unified search endpoint (GET /api/v1/search-index.json) to find slugs by keyword, then fetch full records from detail endpoints: /api/v1/destinations/{slug}.json, /api/v1/picks/{slug}.json, /api/v1/itineraries/{slug}.json, /api/v1/compare/{slug}.json. Destination records include relatedPicks, relatedItineraries, and relatedComparisons for cross-linking. All data is editorially curated from Reddit and verified with Google Places. No API key required. CORS is fully open.
